components.name: Category Label
components.description: Tracked uppercase metadata label; indigo for category, faint for index/caption.
components.css: .ds-label { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #2429af; margin: 0; }

components.name: Read Case Study CTA
components.description: Text link with an arrow glyph that slides right on hover. The primary call to action.
components.css: .ds-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #f3f3f3; text-decoration: none; } .ds-cta-arrow { display: inline-block; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-cta:hover .ds-cta-arrow { transform: translateX(6px); } .ds-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2429af; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Case Cover
components.description: Image frame for a case study: hairline border, panel backing, image scales on hover behind a lightening gradient.
components.css: .ds-cover { position: relative; display: block; aspect-ratio: 640/460; width: 100%; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 2px; border: 1px solid #2e2e2e; background: #222222; } .ds-cover-img { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#2a2a2a,#3d3d3d); transition: transform 900ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-cover:hover .ds-cover-img { transform: scale(1.04); } .ds-cover-grad { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,0.35), transparent 50%); opacity: 0.7; transition: opacity 500ms; } .ds-cover:hover .ds-cover-grad { opacity: 0.4; } .ds-cover-label { position: absolute; left: 20px; bottom: 16px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #9a9a9a; mix-blend-mode: screen; }

narrative.overview: A magazine that moves. The system marries print-grade editorial typography to restrained, deliberate motion: cursor parallax in the hero, scroll-driven reveals, hover that responds. The near-black surface (#0a0a0a) is the page stock; case-study images are the plates; type sets the rhythm. Motion is the signature, the thing that makes editorial rigor feel alive on the web. The personality is thoughtful, grounded, and candid: a first-person voice explaining real decisions to a respected peer. Warmth comes from honest storytelling and unhurried pacing, never from warm-tinted color.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black editorial surface; images are the brightest thing on screen.
Motion is the signature: parallax, scroll reveals, and confident hover, all eased and reduced-motion safe.
Three-voice type system: Instrument Serif italic display, Oswald condensed titles, Inter reading, DM Sans labels.
Saturated accents (indigo, flame) used rarely and deliberately, under 10% of any view.
Tactile, confident components: defined borders, pronounced hover motion, deliberate image lifts.

rules.name: The Indigo-Leads Rule
rules.body: Indigo is the only color allowed to signal interactivity and brand. If something is a link, a category, or the name, it may be indigo; nothing else competes for that job.

rules.name: The One Flame Rule
rules.body: Flame red appears at most once per viewport, on copy, never on chrome. The moment a second flame element appears, the first one stops meaning anything.

rules.name: The No-Warm-Tint Rule
rules.body: Warmth in this brand is carried by voice and pacing. Neutrals stay at or near zero chroma. No cream, sand, or paper-warm body backgrounds.

rules.name: The Italic-Display Rule
rules.body: The serif display voice is always italic and always solo. It carries the hero; it does not appear again as decoration elsewhere.

rules.name: The Tracked-Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is allowed only on DM Sans labels at <=4 words with wide tracking (>=0.16em). No uppercase sentences, no all-caps body.

rules.name: The Ten-Percent Rule
rules.body: Indigo and flame together occupy no more than ~10% of any viewport. The accents are rare and deliberate by doctrine; the dark neutral ramp carries everything else.

rules.name: The Flat-Stock Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. Only imagery casts shadow, and only to separate a plate from the page. UI containers never get shadows.

dos: Do keep #0a0a0a as the room: let case images be the brightest thing on any screen.
Do use Indigo (#2429af) as the single signal for links, categories, and brand; keep it small and high-intent.
Do reserve Flame (#f85050) for one emphasis per viewport, on copy only.
Do keep borders to a single hairline (Line/Edge) and corners near-square (2-3px).
Do pair fonts on a contrast axis and keep labels uppercase only at <=4 words.
Do give every animation a prefers-reduced-motion fallback, and keep revealed content visible by default.
Do verify muted (#9a9a9a) body text stays >=4.5:1 on ink; bump toward white if context drops it.
donts: Don't ship the generic-SaaS look: no purple-to-blue gradients, no identical icon-heading-text card grids, no hero-metric stat blocks, no Inter-for-everything.
Don't clutter: no competing focal points, no wall of sections, no decorative noise.
Don't go corporate/sterile: no stock photography, no faceless agency polish without a point of view.
Don't reach for trend gimmicks: no brutalism-for-its-own-sake, no scroll-jacking, no effect that fights readability.
Don't introduce a warm cream/sand/paper body background; warmth is carried by voice.
Don't use border-left/right greater than 1px as a colored stripe, gradient text, or decorative glassmorphism.
Don't let Flame become a system color or Indigo become a large fill.
Don't add uppercase sentences or all-caps body copy.
